summary: Summit in Oglethorpe County named in a Georgia tower survey (GA087) and the Forest Lookouts index; no source found describes a tower or the site today.

notes_for_editor: The survey row (big mtn, GA087, 33.80440, -83.03184, Oglethorpe, elevation 767 with no unit) is the only source placing a tower here; the record converts 767 to 233.8 m, assuming feet, which the survey does not state. The gazetteer page describes a summit, not a tower. The Forest Lookouts index gives county only. Not in the cached NHLR Georgia index or the FFLOS Georgia list. The Atlanta Trails Georgia tower blog covers four other towers. The anyplaceamerica summit page returned HTTP 403 and was not read. The Commons category of Georgia Forestry Commission towers includes a photo titled 'Georgia Forestry Commission Tower, Oglethorpe'; the place is not verified to be this tower, so it is not used. No source describes a tower at Big Mountain, and the story says so; confidence is low.
